arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
from datetime import date, timedelta
today = date(2026, 9, 7)  # Monday
# "next Wednesday" = Wednesday of the following week (days ahead = (7 - weekday) + 3)
days_ahead = (7 - today.weekday()) + 2  # Wednesday = weekday index 2
next_wed = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)
print("This coming Wednesday:", today + timedelta(days=(2 - today.weekday()) % 7))
print("Next Wednesday:", next_wed)
EOF

python3 - <<'EOF'
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar
    with open('team_meeting_2026-09-16.ics', 'rb') as f:
        cal = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
    for c in cal.walk():
        if c.name == 'VEVENT':
            print("Valid event:", c.get('summary'))
            print("Start:", c.get('dtstart').dt)
            print("End:", c.get('dtend').dt)
    print("ICS file is valid.")
except ImportError:
    print("icalendar not installed; performing basic check instead.")
    text = open('team_meeting_2026-09-16.ics').read()
    required = ['BEGIN:VCALENDAR', 'END:VCALENDAR', 'BEGIN:VEVENT', 'END:VEVENT',
                'UID:', 'DTSTAMP:', 'DTSTART:', 'DTEND:', 'SUMMARY:']
    missing = [r for r in required if r not in text]
    print("OK - required fields present" if not missing else f"MISSING: {missing}")
EOF
